svg.title: Figure 3. Amendments snowball contract value
svg.text: Contract value as a multiple of the original award (geometric mean, with 95% confidence intervals). Chicago, Cook County, Oregon, Washington and DC ledgers (contracts ≥ $1,000).
A. Value path, amendment by amendment
Same contracts throughout: those amended at least 6 times
B. Final value by total number of amendments
Reading: in panel A every line follows one fixed group of contracts, so the climb is compounding, not a change in which contracts are counted. Geometric means damp extreme outliers.

Log scale; each panel has its own axis. Bars: 95% confidence intervals for the geometric mean (mean of logs ± 1.96 SE); sectors are offset slightly so bars do not overlap. Wide bars at 11+ reflect few contracts.

Pooled across ledgers: within the same ledger, software ≈ non-technology and hardware / general technology compound more (robustness_checks.md, R15). DC changes are ordered by option period and version.
